assert not d.seen('job-1', 10)
assert len(d) == 1

arguments.summary: Fixed Deduper's window boundary to treat sightings exactly one window apart as new, and added an expiration queue that removes closed key windows during each call so distinct keys do not accumulate indefinitely. Existing tests pass, along with an additional boundary and cleanup check.
